added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own arms: baseline_suite (study/logs/suite-base.log, revision 06d7280) reports no tests ran (file not found, suite absent at base) and after_suite (study/logs/suite-head-final.log, revision e94c73f90) reports 16 passed with zero failures, so the head arm adds no failing test id over the base. The base arm's EXIT=0 is the status of the trailing `rm -rf "$D"`, not pytest's (the command chains `pytest ...; rm -rf "$D"`), so the base arm is not a readable red control; see finding study/logs/suite-base.log:2.

findings.text: non-blocking: done_when clause (1) requires `the nested class's two slices per sequence as a cross-check row`, but the record's measures table carries no nested-class row and the fragment never mentions the nested class or a cross-check (grep 'nested|cross-check' over the head fragment returns nothing); clause (1) is therefore only partly delivered.

non-blocking: the overlay stops importing and calling nova.media.poloidal.draw_nulls and hand-draws every null marker inline (paint.py:87-156), duplicating a capability the repository owns in nova/media/poloidal.py:draw_nulls and dropping its vessel-containment filter, which that function's docstring documents as measured against out-of-vessel nulls; the added drawing does not extend the owner.

non-blocking: the comment says the `loops` row set 'is the set imas-efit's arm reconstructs from, so the two codes are compared on one information set rather than two', but analyse.DECLARED_ROWS sets nova to `all`, the gate asserts nova's arm is the 72-row set, and the record withdraws any cross-code comparison; the comment contradicts the landed behaviour it sits beside.

non-blocking: the base-arm command chains `pytest ...; rm -rf "$D"` so the captured EXIT=0 is the trailing `rm` status, while pytest itself reported `file or directory not found` and collected no test; the base arm therefore cannot serve as a red control and its exit status does not describe the suite.

non-blocking: the guard suite lives under scripts/prototypes/.../probe_rows/, outside pyproject.toml's pytest `testpaths = ["tests", ...]`, so the repository's default suite never collects it and a regression in analyse.py's reduction would not be caught by CI, only by re-running this node's own gate command.
